SELECT m.member_number AS memberNumber, m.member_id AS memberId, m.member_name AS memberName, m.member_phone_number AS memberPhoneNumber, e.department_code AS departmentCode, d.department_name AS departmentName, e.position_code AS positionCode, p.position_name AS positionName, m.account_status AS accountStatus FROM member m JOIN employee e ON e.member_number = m.member_number LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_code = e.department_code LEFT JOIN position p ON p.position_code = e.position_code WHERE m.member_number = #{memberNumber} AND m.member_status = '직원'
